description: Mutation corpus manifest for t36 / VAL-REL-002. Records the incident classes subjected to mutation testing, the disposable-worktree requirement, and the kill-classification rules that prevent infrastructure failures from being reported as killed mutants.
disposable_worktree_mechanism: Each mutation run creates a temporary directory via mkdtempSync, copies the orchestrator and policies trees into it via cpSync, symlinks node_modules, applies the mutation only to the disposable copy, runs the targeted test in the disposable tree, and removes the disposable tree via rmSync. The original source is never mutated; sourceUnchanged is verified after each run.

kill_classification.killed: The targeted test failed with an assertion failure (exit 1 for pytest, numFailedTests >= 1 with a matching failed assertion for vitest). This is a genuine kill.
kill_classification.infrastructure_error: Spawn failure, timeout, signal kill, missing exit status, or collection/usage error. NOT a kill. Recorded separately and never counted as a successful quality result.
kill_classification.survived: The targeted test passed with the mutation applied. The guard is not genuinely tested.
kill_classification.baseline_failed: The baseline (unmutated) test did not pass, invalidating the mutation check for this class.

infrastructure_failure_policy: Infrastructure failures (spawn error, timeout, signal, missing dependency, collection error) are recorded as infrastructure_error and NEVER reported as a killed mutant or a successful quality result. The quality-gates-summary.json separates infrastructure_errors from threshold failures; a summary with any infrastructure_errors has thresholds_passed=false.
